name: read-first
description: Blocks a tool call until Claude has loaded the guide skill you mapped to that tool. A guide skill is one part rules, one part operating manual. Missing one? The block message says which, and the bundled write-guide-skill skill drafts it in a standard format that a checker verifies.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Which guide skill each tool needs, as tool-pattern => guide, separated by semicolons. A plain pattern is a glob (* matches anything); /regex/ matches anywhere in the tool name. Example: mcp__notion__* => notion-guide; /__send_/ => mail-guide, compliance-guide

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: enforce blocks the call; warn lets it run and tells Claude which guide it skipped

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: Also block MCP tools that no rule covers, and point Claude to write-guide-skill

match.title: Match
match.description: all requires the guide skills of every matching rule; first requires only the first matching rule's, so rule order decides
